 By WPXI.com News Staff November 03, 2026 at 5:17 pm EST By WPXI.com News Staff November 03, 2026 at 5:17 pm EST MT. LEBANON, Pa. — Three people were found dead in Mt. Lebanon on Tuesday, sources tell Channel 11.
 Police Chief Jason Haberman will speak about the incident LIVE on Channel 11 at around 6:15 p.m. Tune in for his update. 
 Click here for photos from the scene. 
 The Mt. Lebanon Police Department said officers are responding to “a police situation” near the municipal building.
 That is on the 700 block of Washington Road.
 Allegheny County dispatchers said the call came in at 4:22 p.m. 
 Police said there is no active threat to the public.
 Firefighters and medics are also at the scene. 
 Channel 11 has a crew heading to the scene and is actively working to learn more. Tune in to Channel 11 News at 6 p.m. for the latest details on this developing story.
